name: alakazam-studio
description: Alakazam Creator Studio — a standalone reference app built entirely on the public /v1 API. Create, edit, version, and play programmable worlds; share with your users. No internal dependencies.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:app
scripts.test:e2e: playwright test tests/no-key.spec.ts tests/panels-author.spec.ts tests/panels-worlds.spec.ts tests/smoke.spec.ts --forbid-only --trace=retain-on-failure
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:conventions && npm run test:unit && npm run build:app && npm run test:e2e
